text: Illustration. A different car, April 20th account
In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek.
observed: Option A 15.0 to 15.8 s. Wide creek holds to 15.2 s. At 15.4 s a closer shot shows the white car sunk to mid-door in brown water with a wake trailing right; it slides left across the creek between 15.4 and 15.6 s and slows by 15.8 s. Empty seats show through the windows. The car stays level, with no visible tilt.
